items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met him, because I was working in Toledo with Art, and he’d come to see Art. That’s how we met.

ctx.x: He was one of the ten best jazz pianists. He could play. I met him, because I was working in Toledo with Art, and he’d come to see Art. That’s how we met. But he was a great jazz musician, very hip.
I guess this is – what? – in the ’52 to ’54 time period? You had written Four Brothers. I guess you were doing a lot of writing during that period.
